title: Malaysian-Style Stir Fry with Sweet Cherry Sauce
description: A sweet and savory stir fry dish inspired by Malaysian flavors, featuring a cherry sauce and various vegetables.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and bell pepper and stir-fry until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the snow peas and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes, until they are tender but still crisp.
Add the cooked stir-fry rice to the wok or skillet and stir-fry for about 2 minutes, until the rice is well combined with the vegetables.
In a small bowl, whisk together the sweet chili sauce and 2 tablespoons of water to create the cherry sauce.
Pour the cherry sauce over the rice and vegetables, and stir-fry for another minute, until everything is well coated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the stir-fry to a serving platter or individual plates, and serve hot.
